subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive with ML/Infra team
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive with ML/Infra team

Hi Jordan + Priya —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Appreciate you walking us through the data flows and the primary latency and security constraints. As discussed, the next step would be a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams so we can: 1) review the integration points (batch vs real-time), 2) align on data retention and audit requirements, and 3) validate performance/latency targets and model selection.

Proposed attendees from our side:
- Marissa Cole (you) — Sales
- Camila Reyes — Technical Account Executive
- Dylan Brooks — Solutions Engineer (inference/runtime)

Can you share 2–3 windows next week that work for your ML and infra folks (60–90 min)? We’ll include an agenda and slide deck beforehand.

Draft agenda (high level):
- 5m: intros + goals
- 10m: recap of discovery + constraints
- 30–45m: technical deep dive (data paths, auth/KMS, VPC, latency SLOs, batch vs streaming)
- 10–20m: rollout options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) + quantization/throughput considerations
- 10m: next steps / action items

I’ve attached a short agenda doc and our one-pager on deployment options for reference. If you prefer, we can set a tentative invite and adjust once you confirm attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments:
- acme_tech_deep_dive_agenda.docx
- redwood-capabilities-one-pager.pdf

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive with ML/Infra team

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Priya and I chatted and here are some windows that work for our ML + infra leads (we'd prefer late morning PT):
- Tue 7/6 10:30–12:00 PT
- Wed 7/7 11:00–12:30 PT
- Thu 7/8 10:00–11:30 PT

Attendees on our side (confirmed):
- Jordan Lee — Product Lead (owner)
- Priya Singh — Head of Data Platform
- Naveen Rao — ML Engineering Manager (naveen.rao@acmehealth.com)
- Allison Park — Infra Lead (allison.park@acmehealth.com)

We’ll be prepared to walk through data schemas, current inference pipeline (batch scoring + a small real-time path), and where audit logs need to be captured.

If you can pick a slot and send a calendar invite, we’ll accept.

—Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive with ML/Infra team

Great — thanks for the options and the attendee list. I’ll lock in Tue 7/6 10:30–12:00 PT since that matches your preference.

Ethan, looping you in — can you and Dylan cover the runtime and infra questions (VPC/peering, KMS/HSM, KV cache behavior, and expected latency profiles)? Specifically:
- Short (10–15m) overview of Redwood Dedicated vs Private for strict VPC/KMS requirements
- 20–30m deep-dive on the serving runtime: batching, KV cache, quantization options and what to expect in throughput/latency
- 10m on rollout patterns and fallback strategies (canary, A/B, automatic fallbacks)

Jordan/Priya — attaching the agenda doc and our one-pager again; I’ll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read.

Tentative calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-123
Pre-read (agenda): https://drive.google.com/open?id=agenda123

If that slot still looks good to you, I’ll send the invite now.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments:
- acme_tech_deep_dive_agenda.docx
- redwood-capabilities-one-pager.pdf

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: scheduling technical deep dive with ML/Infra team

Sounds good — I’ll take the runtime/infra sections and will prepare a short slide deck covering:
- networking (VPC peering, private endpoints)
- key management and audit logging (KMS/HSM integration patterns)
- expected latency ranges by model class and quantization level (examples)
- guidance on batching and KV cache tuning for mixed real-time + batch workloads

I’ll coordinate with Dylan on the demo snippets and bring example telemetry screenshots for discussion. See you all on 7/6.

—Ethan
